script.meaning: Thought I would just get a small hook. This stainless steel rack gives two full sets.
script.scenes: Model holds one simple steel hook in hand, looking at it casually.; Model swings down two fully loaded stainless steel racks, showing the volume of utensils held.

research.audience: Indian homemakers managing small or cluttered kitchens
research.problem: Messy kitchen counters and drawers making it hard to find tools quickly while cooking
research.buyer_moment: Searching frantically for a specific spatula while the tadka is sizzling on the stove
research.surprise_detail: It comes as a pack of two racks instead of just one
research.people_reason: To show the hands hanging various utensils onto the racks for organization

script.facts: Pack of 2 racks; Stainless steel material

style.label: storyteller reveal
style.brief: a calm storyteller narrator. Line 1 sets a tiny scene or builds curiosity, line 2 reveals the product as the surprise. Slightly dramatic, storybook tone, still plain everyday words.
style.voice_line: Voice: calm, warm storyteller narrator, speaking everyday Hindi. Pronounce every word clearly and exactly as written, do not skip, merge or change any word.
style.ad_brief: AD LEVEL = light: no pitch and no praise. The product is named or shown once, in passing, like a friend mentioning it.
style.caption_tone: Keep the caption casual: one friendly line plus one short mention of what the product is, no pitch.
style.caption_cta: Comment LINK to get the link in your DM
style.overlay: Show big, clear on-screen text captions, spelled exactly: Hang it all, then Comment LINK.
